archetypes.name: sentinel-lifecycle
archetypes.rationale: The plan hinges on preserving completion-marker side effects across merged, override, and re-entry paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check whether the plan accounts for every legacy completion sentinel written by Step 2b and Step 2b.5 across initial, Gate B, discussion-round2, and Gate A re-entry paths. Compare the proposed sentinel writes against the existing skill prose and reference flows, especially clean paths, override-after-defects paths, and standalone retained callers. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: caller-contract-sync
archetypes.rationale: Multiple docs and retained callers must agree on the new merged driver contract without drifting from standalone behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit whether the plan updates every caller contract touched by adding design-postplan-emit.sh --with-plan-size while keeping check-plan-size.sh standalone-compatible. Look for mismatches among SKILL.md, approval-gates, discussion-rounds, flags, script docs, and test docs around exit codes, prompts, result-env keys, and retained Step 2b.5 callers. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: operator-diagnostics
archetypes.rationale: The change moves judgment into a thin fence, making diagnostic preservation and KV/display separation easy to regress.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the plan gives enough implementation and test detail to preserve operator-facing diagnostics after merging emit, validation, and plan-size checks. Focus on rc1 failure-specific messages, rc2/rc3 nonfatal logging, WARN display without KV leakage, FD3 behavior, and AskUserQuestion trigger conditions by site. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
